Question: Topic :Taharah (Purity) AsSalamalaikum, In summer days clothes becomes wet due to sweat, It is necessary to sit on chairs, in public places and public transports etc with wet clothes ,it is question about the ?paki? of that benches and chairs Will my clothes remain pak to offer Namaz after this situation? JajakAllah.. Answer ID: 14874 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1308/1308=M/1430) Sweat is tahir (clean), if cloth is wet with sweat it will not be regarded unclean. Thus the bench or chair will not be regarded as unclean and you can perform salah in those clothes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
